# Balaji Amines Limited

Balaji Amines Limited is one of India's leading chemical manufacturing companies, headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1988, the company has grown to become a prominent player in the production of aliphatic amines, specialty chemicals, and their derivatives. Over the decades, Balaji Amines has carved a niche for itself both in the domestic and international markets, earning a strong reputation for quality, innovation, and reliability.

The company specializes in manufacturing a wide range of methylamines, ethylamines, and other specialty chemicals that serve as critical raw materials and intermediates for numerous industries, including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, water treatment, rubber processing, paints and coatings, and personal care products. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities located in Maharashtra, Balaji Amines has consistently invested in expanding its production capacities and upgrading its technology to meet the growing demands of a diverse customer base.

Balaji Amines is publicly listed on Indian stock exchanges and has demonstrated consistent financial growth over the years. The company places a strong emphasis on research and development, enabling it to develop new products and improve existing processes. Committed to sustainable business practices, environmental responsibility, and adherence to stringent quality standards, Balaji Amines continues to strengthen its position as a market leader in the Indian chemical industry while expanding its global footprint across several countries worldwide.
